title: Delete requests sent from the admin app vanish from HQ with no warning when the website database cannot be read
what: When the small website database does not answer, the Delete requests page simply leaves out the list New from the admin app. Nothing on the page says that part could not be read, so the page looks as if no owner asked for a delete, while the 30-day clock of each request keeps running.
expected: A warning that requests from the admin app could not be read right now, as Needs you already does for its own counts.
how_often: each time the website database does not answer while the page is opened
fix_line: Show a warning on the page when the admin app list could not be read
